instruction: Add a column E titled 'Digit Count'. For each customer, compute how many digits their Old ID has and put that number in column E.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully copied Old IDs to New 7 Digit ID column, padding with leading zeros to 7 digits in 13 turns. Used LibreOffice Calc formulas/formatting.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open and edit LibreOffice Calc spreadsheets, use formulas like TEXT() for zero-padding, copy formulas across rows, handle column operations
metadata.explanation: New task using same spreadsheet: add column E with count of digits in each Old ID. Getter reads column E header and values, metric checks header (10%) and each value (90%) with partial credit.
metadata.task_rationale: Model demonstrated spreadsheet formula capability; testing a different formula operation (LEN or digit counting) on the same data.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads column E (column 5) header and values from rows 2-30, matching the 29 expected data rows
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter keys directly (expected.get('expected_header'), expected.get('expected_values')) — proper handling for type='rule'
Both instruction requirements are verified: column E header title (10% weight) and digit count values (90% weight with per-row partial credit)
Postconfig properly activates the window and saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads, ensuring fresh data
Getter handles float-to-int conversion and None values robustly
Scoring breakdown is reasonable: 10% header + 90% values with partial credit per row
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Expected digit count values cannot be independently verified without access to the actual spreadsheet data. If Old IDs have leading zeros stored as text, LEN() would count them but digit counting might differ — ensure expected values account for the actual storage format.
Minor: Header check uses substring match ('in') rather than exact match, which is lenient but acceptable for this use case.
